name: Pointcloud to Sparse Voxel Grid Conversion
definition: Converts a pointcloud into a sparse voxel grid representation, storing only voxels that contain points.
summary: Pointcloud to Sparse Voxel Grid Conversion maps unstructured 3D points into a discrete, sparse voxel grid using structured spatial partitioning, differing from direct hash-map accumulation by prioritizing depth confidence in aggregation.
